hints.title: Sort Both Collections
hints.text: Sort both the seats and the students in non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Pair by Rank
hints.text: Pair the i-th smallest seat with the i-th smallest student position.

hints.title: Sum of Displacements
hints.text: Accumulate the absolute differences between matched pairs.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N log N) sorting seats and students
complexity.space: O(1) or O(N) depending on in-place sort
variables: N: number of students and seats
complexity.notes: Sorting both arrays matches closest available pairs without crossing paths.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Bipartite matching algorithm is overkill and takes cubic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting once provides optimal greedy pairings in minimal code.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that non-crossing moves minimize total absolute distance.
